big_case.notes: A private, fact-bound protective-order dispute in an interlocutory posture from a high-profile adoption/custody litigation. The legal questions (appellate party presentation; a prior restraint sustained on an unbriefed national-security rationale) have some reach, but the vehicle is narrow, the circuit conflict is thin, and the petition was denied at its first conference without a called-for response. Public profile exceeds doctrinal stakes.
